title: Content pillars
intro: The 3–5 themes your posts are about, and how much of your content each one should get.
confirmDelete: Delete this pillar? Its posts are kept.
emptyText: For example: Tips & recipes, Offers, Behind the scenes, Customer reviews.
totalOff: Targets add up to {total} — aim for 100%.
tip1: Keep 3 to 5 pillars: enough variety, easy to remember.
tip2: Promotions work better when they are around 20–30% of your posts.
tip3: Pick a pillar when you write a post: the Planner shows if your mix drifts.
name: Name
descriptionHint: What belongs here, with an example or two.
